title: Pantoken A2UI Catalog
description: A constrained set of Pantoken-styled components for A2UI v1.0 web clients.

PantokenIcon.description: An inline glyph selected from Pantoken's icon set.

PantokenButton.description: A token-styled action button with optional A2UI event and Invoker Commands behavior.

PantokenAlert.description: A status message with optional timeout dismissal.

PantokenBadge.description: A compact count or status badge.

PantokenAvatar.description: An initials avatar with a constrained palette, size, and shape.

PantokenProgress.description: A horizontal progress or meter indicator.

PantokenMetric.description: A large value paired with a descriptive label.

PantokenRating.description: A read-only star rating with a bounded number of stars.

PantokenProgressCircle.description: A circular progress or meter indicator.

PantokenIconButton.description: An icon-only button with an accessible label.

PantokenToggleButton.description: A two-state button whose pressed state is bound to A2UI data.

PantokenTruncate.description: A clamped text region with an allowlisted line count.

PantokenImg.description: A responsive image with a sanitized media URL and constrained presentation.

PantokenSideNavBar.description: A vertical navigation rail that can collapse to icon-only presentation.

PantokenTreeBrowser.description: An accessible tree whose child components are exposed as focusable tree items.

PantokenCalendar.description: An interactive month calendar that updates its selected ISO date.

PantokenTooltip.description: A noninteractive tooltip around a trigger component.

PantokenModal.description: A native dialog with command-driven open and close behavior.

PantokenContextView.description: A callout popover with Pantoken styling.

PantokenTray.description: A viewport-edge popover panel with constrained placement and size.

PantokenInPlaceEdit.description: An inline editable value with A2UI state updates.

PantokenDrilldown.description: A nested menu built from safe page and item data.

PantokenPages.description: A history-aware set of A2UI child panels.

PantokenDrawerLayout.description: A responsive content and tray layout with command-driven open state.

PantokenDateInput.description: A date field with a calendar popover and ISO value updates.

PantokenDateTimeInput.description: A combined date and time field with an ISO value update.

PantokenTabs.description: An accessible tab set pairing A2UI child panels with labels.

PantokenCard.description: A Pantoken card component with safe text and child content.

PantokenByline.description: A Pantoken byline component with safe text and child content.

PantokenTable.description: A data table with a caption, column headers, and text-only cells.

PantokenLink.description: A navigable text link with an allowlisted URL scheme.

PantokenList.description: A Pantoken list component with safe text and child content.

PantokenCheckbox.description: A native checkbox with a visible label and checked-state updates.

PantokenRadio.description: A native radio control with a visible label and selected-value updates.

PantokenMenu.description: A Pantoken menu component with safe text and child content.

PantokenBreadcrumb.description: A labeled navigation landmark with breadcrumb items.

PantokenBillboard.description: A Pantoken billboard component with safe text and child content.

PantokenToggleGroup.description: A token-styled disclosure group with a summary and expandable child content.

PantokenPagination.description: A labeled navigation landmark for pagination controls.

PantokenToggleDetails.description: A native disclosure with a summary and expandable child content.

PantokenFileDrop.description: A Pantoken file-drop component with safe text and child content.

PantokenRangeInput.description: A native range slider with bounded numeric values.

PantokenMask.description: A Pantoken mask component with safe text and child content.

PantokenScreenReaderContent.description: A Pantoken screen-reader-content component with safe text and child content.

PantokenHeading.description: A Pantoken heading component with safe text and child content.

PantokenText.description: A Pantoken text component with safe text and child content.

PantokenCloseButton.description: An accessible close control that dispatches an A2UI click action.

PantokenFormField.description: A Pantoken form-field component with safe text and child content.

PantokenFormFieldGroup.description: A labeled fieldset grouping related form controls.

PantokenRadioInputGroup.description: A labeled fieldset grouping related radio controls.

PantokenFormFieldMessages.description: A Pantoken form-field-messages component with safe text and child content.

PantokenTextInput.description: A native text input with a visible label and value updates.

PantokenTextArea.description: A native multiline text field with a visible label and value updates.

PantokenSimpleSelect.description: A labeled select control with bounded, text-only options.

PantokenInputGroup.description: A Pantoken input-group component with safe text and child content.

PantokenNumberInput.description: A native number input with bounded values and a visible label.

PantokenView.description: A Pantoken view component with safe text and child content.
